actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The glabrezu's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). The glabrezu can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .S7VbUetIfVT7B6Eq]]{darkness}, [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .15Fa6q1nH27XfbR8]]{dispel magic} 1/day each: [[/item .9hQXdMSmerkTsHDe]]{confusion}, [[/item .yfbK8gZqESlaoY5t]]{fly}, [[/item .35j2QIMmIk6aEdxj]]{power word stun}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes four attacks: two with its [[/item .pEUD99mri5iDNGH7]]{pincers} and two with its [[/item .VGFZM2Zvp0NT5Yb9]]{fists}. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its pincers and casts one spell.

actions.name: pincer
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is &reference[grappled] (escape DC 15). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has two [[lookup @item.name lowercase]]s, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
